foreignQualification.feeBasis: Online filing fee of $750.00; paper filing adds the $15.00 paper filing fee ($765.00 total, stated on the form).
foreignQualification.formName: Application for Certificate of Authority (Foreign Limited Liability Company)
foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File the annual report ($55.00 online / $70.00 paper) and maintain a registered agent in South Dakota.

evidence.quote: Foreign Limited Liability Companies: Foreign Forms are used by organizations whose state of incorporation is NOT South Dakota. Application for Certificate of Authority

Foreign Certificate of Authority Filed Electronically online $750 Filed via Paper (includes paper filing fee) $765 Annual Report Filed Electronically online $55 Filed via Paper (includes paper filing fee) $70
APPLICATION FOR CERTIFICATE OF AUTHORITY FOREIGN LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY SDCL 47-34A-1002 FILING FEE: $765
Secretary of State Office 500 E Capitol Ave Pierre, SD 57501
Cancellation of Certificate of Authority Annual Report File Online File by Paper (*fee includes the additional $15 paper filing fee)

notes: The common filing path is online at $750; the paper form states $765 including the $15 paper filing fee. The annual report applies to foreign LLCs ($55 online / $70 paper), matching root states.json's $55 figure; the paper form also requires a certificate of existence from the home state.
